audit.whatIsWrong: The page credits Aurora with a root she does not have, and calls The Weirding (E) a blink while ignoring Across the Veil (W).
audit.why: Riot's text: Twofold Hex (Q, 9s, 900 range) curses and is recast to drag the curses back; Across the Veil (W, 22/21/20/19/18s) is the leap into invisibility plus move speed; The Weirding (E, 15s) damages, slows and hops her backward; Between Worlds (R, 140/120/100s) slows in a zone she can teleport across. Nothing in the kit roots.
audit.corrected: Root claims removed everywhere they appeared; the slow-and-hop, the 22s stealth leap and the 900-range poke now carry the advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3-6 disagreed with the whys beside them: 4-5 and 6 were Skill while the text says she is ahead, and first item / 2+ items were Aurora while the text calls the lethality spike Lucian's window back.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Lucian/Skill/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora/Lucian/Lucian, which matches the prose; the shipped rows did not.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Aurora, rows 5 and 6 to Lucian, as matched full/content pairs with ratings adjusted.

audit.why: Spike order is right — level 2 burst, her 3-5 spacing control, her level 6, then Lucian's lethality first item — it was only the chart rows that disagreed with it.
audit.corrected: Between Worlds' 140s at rank 1 added so the level-6 spike is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing despite Spirit Abjuration.
audit.why: Her passive exorcises spirits from every enemy she damages and they heal her, so extended trades swing on Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Executioner's added to the itemization line and the anti-heal reason stated in late.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Across the Veil (Hop) — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Twofold Hex out-ranges you at 900 and Across the Veil (22s) undoes every dash — poke and farm, do not chase her spacing.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Between Worlds (140s) slows you in its zone and she teleports across it — the channel on The Culling is wasted there.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: Serrated Dirk into Eclipse puts her squishy frame back inside one Q-W-E double-shot string — force the all-in the moment it lands.

edits.before: Level 2 Q + Lightslinger is your single biggest burst window, but she can answer the moment her E and root come up — genuinely even who lands first.
edits.after: Level 2 Q + Lightslinger is your biggest burst window, but The Weirding's slow-and-hop answers it the moment she has it — even who lands first.

edits.before: With E (blink) and her root online she controls spacing: she blinks out of your W-dash and roots you on the exit while her Q out-ranges your autos.
edits.after: With The Weirding (15s) and Across the Veil (22s) she controls spacing: she slows you, hops away, and her 900-range Q out-ranges your autos.

edits.before: She stays ahead as her root and Q poke accumulate and your mana strains — you can't reach her without eating the blink-and-root.
edits.after: She stays ahead as Twofold Hex poke stacks and your mana strains — reaching her costs a slow, a hop away, and a spirit heal.

edits.before: Once she has E (Twofold blink) plus her root, she controls spacing — every time you W-dash in she blinks out and roots you on the way back, and her Q out-ranges your autos.
edits.after: Once she has The Weirding (15s) and Across the Veil (22s) she controls spacing — you dash in, she slows you and hops back, and her 900-range Twofold Hex out-ranges your autos.

edits.before: This is where she takes the lane. With E (her short blink) and her root online she controls every engage: you W-mark and dash in, she blinks out, and roots you on the exit so her Q poke and burst land free. At 6 her ult is the problem — Between Worlds can exile you out of the fight or trap you in its zone, which wastes The Culling's channel entirely. Respect her blink timer: only all-in when her E is on cooldown, and never burn your E dash chasing a blink you can't catch.
edits.after: This is where she takes the lane. With The Weirding's slow-and-hop and Across the Veil's 22-second leap into invisibility she controls every engage: you W-mark and dash in, she blasts you, hops back, and her 900-range Twofold Hex poke lands free. At 6 her ult is the problem — Between Worlds (140s at rank 1) slows you inside its zone and lets her teleport across it, which wastes The Culling's channel entirely. Only all-in while Across the Veil is down, and never burn your E chasing her out of it.

edits.before: You are the weaker scaler here and she knows it — full-AP Aurora pokes with Q, holds the blink, and one combo plus a root deletes your low base HP. Your real window back is your first lethality item: Serrated Dirk into Eclipse or Youmuu's puts her squishy frame inside a single Q-W-E-double-shot burst again, so force that all-in the second it's up while she's still building. If you let it go even into two items, her AP burst out-damages your kit and you lose the straight 1v1.
edits.after: You are the weaker scaler here and she knows it — full-AP Aurora pokes with Twofold Hex, holds Across the Veil, and one combo into her slow deletes your low base HP. Your real window back is your first lethality item: Serrated Dirk into Eclipse or Youmuu's puts her squishy frame inside a single Q-W-E-double-shot burst again, so force that all-in the moment it's up. Buy Grievous Wounds first — Spirit Abjuration heals her off every spell she lands, and untraded chip does nothing.

edits.before: Hold E (the blink) for your W-dash engage so she escapes the trade and roots you leaving
edits.after: Hold Across the Veil for your dash engage so she leaps out invisible and the trade whiffs

edits.before: Land Q poke and her root from outside your auto range and stack it while you can't reach her
edits.after: Land Twofold Hex from 900 range and recast it back through you while you cannot reach her

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver into Berserker's Greaves; then Navori / The Collector by lane state.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver into Berserker's Greaves; buy Executioner's early — she heals off spells.

notes: The page invented a root for Aurora and called The Weirding a blink; both are now corrected across full and content. Packet suspectName "The Culling's" is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is Lucian's real ultimate name. No anti-heal or shield advice written for Lucian's own passive: Lightslinger only empowers when an ALLY heals or shields him (same conclusion the mirror slice reached).
